column3: The 1010 Pacific Declaration provides for various remedies of the HPD in the event of a default by the borrower under such documents. The 1010 Pacific Declaration provides that the HPD may enforce such document through the exercise of remedies at law or in equity. The 1010 Pacific Subordination Agreement provides that upon a declaration of default under the 1010 Pacific Declaration, the HPD must give the lender notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure (if such default can be cured). If the lender cures the default during the cure period (if any) or has commenced to cure the default within such period and is diligently pursuing completion of such cure, or has commenced the exercise of remedies under the Mortgage Loan documents within such period, the HPD may not exercise its remedies under the 1010 Pacific Declaration by reason of such default; provided that the foregoing does not limit its right to consent to a replacement manager.
